name: FiberDC Teknoloji (FiberDC Global Datacenter)
notes: DataCenterMap and Data Center Catalog list FiberDC Teknoloji as a colocation data center at Carsi Mah. Kutlu Han No:3, 53100 Rize; Yandex Maps and Cybo record the operating entity FiberDC Global Datacenter Ltd. Sti. (fiberdc.com.tr), an ISP offering telco racks and server space in Rize. No capacity disclosed in public sources.

name: Sakarya Veri Merkezi
notes: A Turkish web brand 'Sakarya Veri Merkezi' markets colocation, cloud server and dedicated server services under a Sakarya name; however, no physical facility address, registration or independent corroboration could be found, and no larger Sakarya data center project surfaced in news or industry listings. Included for completeness; unverified.

name: Earth Veri Merkezi
notes: DataCenterMap lists Earth Veri Merkezi as Samsun's only colocation/cloud data center; the provider states it currently offers server colocation at one location in Samsun, Turkey. A June 2026 Sabah column confirms one working data center in Samsun. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Turkcell Avrupa Veri Merkezi (Europe Data Center)
notes: Turkcell's Europe Data Center (Avrupa Veri Merkezi) opened on 13 September 2021 in the Kapakli district of Tekirdag (Karaagac OSB) with Transport and Infrastructure Minister Adil Karaismailoglu attending. Tier III certified and LEED Gold, about 37,277 sqm site / 43,000 sqm closed area / ~7,238 sqm white space across 3 modules, over 2.5 billion TL invested, and a 75% domestic-content ratio. Official announcements did not disclose MW capacity; a Turkish market analysis (Evren Ozmen) reports the facility operates at 16+ MW, so capacity_mw=16 is an analyst estimate.
